title: Bar Drop Blueberry Sour Raspberry 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Blueberry Sour Raspberry by Drop is a bold berry blend that plays on the contrast between sweet and sour. The inhale offers the deep, jammy sweetness of blueberries, providing a rich foundation. This is instantly countered by a sharp, tangy raspberry note on the exhale that adds a mouth-watering sour kick, keeping the flavour profile dynamic and engaging. This e-liquid utilises a 40% VG / 60% PG ratio to amplify the sour notes, ensuring the tanginess is pronounced and refreshing. Ideally suited for low-wattage MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) devices, the nicotine salt base ensures a smooth and comfortable draw, available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. Manufactured by UK brand Drop, Bar Drop Salts range of nic salt e-liquids focus on fruity flavours that are endlessly popular as well as a few unique profiles you won’t find anywhere else.
